parts.blurb: 40-pin connector to a separate Radxa Zero 3W compute board carrying the Rockchip RK3566. The large Pi Zero-shaped footprint is a mechanical clearance reference, not chips on this HAT.

blocks.label: RK3566 compute board
blocks.description: The 40-pin J4 header mates with a separate Radxa Zero 3W. The RK3566 is on that board, not on this HAT.

blocks.label: Battery and regulation
blocks.description: Motor input +BATT feeds the HAT; U9 generates the 5 V rail for the compute board.

blocks.label: Dynamixel buses
blocks.description: TTL and RS-485 motor connections leave through J3, J11, J13 and J14.

blocks.label: Motion sensor
blocks.description: U12 is the LSM6DSV16X inertial sensor on the HAT.

blocks.label: Audio
blocks.description: The codec, microphone and amplifier handle Microduck's audio path.
